fran_sales: Heads-up — POC with MeridianHealth hit 429s mid-demo and they pushed back: they need an auditable change (SOC2) before infra can do any temporary overrides.

fran_sales: They started bulk embed import + realtime suggestions at ~10:15 CET. Error: `429 Too Many Requests` with header sample:
```
X-RDX-Limit: 8000
X-RDX-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 3
X-RDX-Window: 60
```

diego_se: Understood. Can we get the request pattern? batch sizes, concurrency, SDK? Also which tenant id?

fran_sales: tenant=meridianhealth. Their script runs 10 workers, embed_batch=128, plus 12 chat requests/sec. Using rdx-js 0.9.2.

marie_ops: Quick console snapshot: tenant=meridianhealth tier=enterprise monthly_commit=1M burst_window_s=60 burst_tokens=8000 current_window_used=7985

audit_bot: [policy] any infra override that affects SLA or capacity requires documented approval: approver=sales_manager and audit_tag required.

fran_sales: Customer insists we provide an audit trail (who/when/reason) before applying any quotas. They also want confirmation this won't affect other tenants.

diego_se: Two questions: 1) can we propose a client workaround they can perform immediately? 2) if infra does an override, can we emit an auditable event with a signed ID? We already have reserve API but need the SOC2 note.

tony_support: Fast client workarounds (lowest friction): reduce embed workers to 4, set embed_batch=64, add 429 backoff with jitter. We can give them an ephemeral CLI snippet to run during the demo.

fran_sales: They prefer not to change code mid-demo. Are we able to do an override with full audit metadata?

marie_ops: Yes — infra can apply a short-lived burst reservation, but we must capture metadata: approver, reason, ticket link, and signed id. We can also apply it to a shadow capacity pool (demo-only) so other prod tenants unaffected. Need explicit approval from sales_manager.

fran_sales: I have approval from sales_manager via DM. Approve applying a 90m demo reservation scoped to demo pool. Please attach audit tag `deal/meridianhealth/poc` and ticket INT-4032.

marie_ops: Applying reservation now: id=resv-20260322-3100 scope=demo-pool tokens=6000 ttl=5400 applied_by=marie_ops audit_tag=deal/meridianhealth/poc ticket=INT-4032

audit_bot: [audit-log] event=reservation_applied id=resv-20260322-3100 by=marie_ops tag=deal/meridianhealth/poc ticket=INT-4032 signature=sha256:abc123def456 expires=176901*placeholder*

diego_se: Can we paste the small proxy log around the failure window to confirm pattern?

marie_ops: Trimmed logs (epoch s):
```
[1769012352] tenant=meridianhealth route=/v1/embeddings tokens=980 bucket_before=1200 bucket_after=220
[1769012353] tenant=meridianhealth route=/v1/chat tokens=200 bucket_before=220 bucket_after=20
[1769012354] tenant=meridianhealth route=/v1/embeddings tokens=320 bucket_before=20 bucket_after=-300 throttle=1 -> 429
```

tony_support: That looks like burst exhaustion. Reservation should give them headroom. Also recommend we enable a demo-safe runtime guard: when tenant is flagged as demo, cap concurrent workers server-side to a sane default to avoid surprises.

fran_sales: Customer also asked about pricing: will the reservation be billed or is it a free presales courtesy? They want clarity for legal.

marie_ops: Policy: presales/demo reservations <=4h are recorded internally and not charged; anything longer is reviewed. We'll include that in the audit event metadata.

docs_bot: Created presales note: `presales/meridianhealth-poc-audit.md` with reservation details and runbook link.

fran_sales: Customer confirmed demo completed after reservation was applied. They appreciated the signed audit ID.

marie_ops: Follow-ups noted: 1) infra to add a demo-mode that auto-applies conservative concurrency caps for flagged tenants, 2) docs to add SOC2-friendly override checklist and template approval message for sales, 3) SDK teams to add a preflight estimate endpoint so customers can check before big imports. Filed tickets: RUNTIME-3301 (demo-mode caps), DOCS-912 (SOC2 override runbook), SDK-1204 (preflight api).

fran_sales: Please attach the doc link to CRM. Thanks everyone, closing out POC notes. :white_check_mark:
